root_cause.text: The batman-adv OGM aggregation logic did not verify that the target skb has sufficient tailroom before appending a new packet, leading to an skb_put overflow when the existing skb was originally allocated with only enough space for a single packet.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that "An existing forwarded packet may have been allocated with only packet_len bytes, while a later packet can still be selected for aggregation. Appending in this case can hit skb_put overflow conditions." The patch adds a check for `skb_tailroom(forw_packet->skb) < packet_len` to reject aggregation when tailroom is insufficient.
